modules.name: Round-2 discovery (the wide search, keyless via agent-reach's Jina Reader channel)
acceptance: the candidates file exists with one row per candidate URL
every row carries source_id, source_type, query and discovery_channel
no URL appears twice
the run log states the number of queries run and how many returned nothing

modules.name: Round-2 source list and query set
acceptance: every source carries a source_type from the closed 7-type set
every source carries a licence_default and at least one query
the unfillable array carries the 13 Track A families forward

modules.name: Harvester round-2 support (candidate-list strategy, byte cap, additive manifest fields, candidate log, French stages, licence rows per attempted source, round filter)
acceptance: npx tsx scripts/harvest-track-a.ts selftest passes
the round-1 report is byte-unchanged (git diff --exit-code)
the candidate log has exactly one row per candidate examined
no byte is written past the 5 GiB cumulative cap or the 100 MiB per-document cap
the round filter keeps round-2 rows out of the round-1 report

modules.name: Round-2 report generator (AC1-AC4) and its vitest guard
acceptance: regenerating the report leaves the committed file byte-identical
the vitest guard passes
the coverage table's before column equals the committed round-1 numbers
the yield table's in-scope column equals the coverage table's attribution
every attempted source type has a row, including honest zeros
no T0/T1 row appears in any coverage cell

modules.name: Live round-2 execution and committed corpus artefacts
acceptance: every ingested manifest row has a matching candidate-log row
every source attempted has a licence-register row
no binary is tracked by git (git ls-files docs/RSA-Documents | grep -ci '\.pdf$' == 0)
the round-1 report has no diff
the byte accounting file's arithmetic holds and corpusBytesAfter <= capBytes
